user.title: Add a PTLevel receiver
user.description: Enter the address of a PTLevel WiFi receiver on your network. Receivers do not announce themselves, so give each one a DHCP reservation first.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the receiver.

reconfigure.title: Change the receiver's address
reconfigure.description: Enter the receiver's new address. It must be the same receiver; to add a different one, add a new entry instead.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the receiver.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a PTLevel receiver at that address.
error.unsupported_receiver: Something answered at that address, but not a supported PTLevel receiver. Only Version 1 receivers (firmware 2xx, no button on the front) are supported so far.

abort.wrong_device: That address answers as a different receiver. To add it, add a new entry instead.
